build_scatter_plot_node: build a labgraph ScatterPlot node that renders scatter plots from incoming messages using pyqtgraph
create_scatter_plot_style: create a ScatterPlotStyle dataclass to configure pen, symbol, symbolBrush, and symbolSize for plot points
configure_scatter_plot_config: configure a ScatterPlotConfig with x_field, y_field, labels, styles, axis ranges, and alpha settings
review_scatter_plot_update: review the ScatterPlot update method that clears and sets data on each subplot from state data
test_scatter_plot_got_message: test the ScatterPlot got_message subscriber that extracts x and y field values from incoming messages
